share.coda.label.comment: Section label of the share block at the end of the piece page (shown uppercase).

share.coda.line.en: If it stayed with you, pass it on.
share.coda.line.comment: Line beside the share card preview in the coda block.

share.coda.button.comment: Solid button in the coda block; opens the share preview.

share.coda.preview.accessibilityLabel.comment: VoiceOver label of the small card preview in the coda block (opens the share preview).

share.moment.menu.comment: Menu item on a long-press of a listening stop card.

share.preview.title.piece.comment: Title of the share preview sheet for a piece.

share.preview.title.moment.comment: Title of the share preview sheet for one listening stop.

share.preview.format.story.comment: Share preview format choice: tall image for stories.

share.preview.format.post.comment: Share preview format choice: feed image (the default).

share.preview.share.comment: Share preview button; opens the iOS share sheet.

share.preview.image.accessibilityLabel.en: Share image: the painting with the piece’s label
share.preview.image.accessibilityLabel.tr: Paylaşım görseli: tablo ve eserin etiketi
share.preview.image.accessibilityLabel.comment: VoiceOver label of the card preview in the share preview sheet.

share.text.piece %@ %@ %@.en: %1$@, %2$@. %3$@ Listen with the guide on DailyClassical:
share.text.piece %@ %@ %@.comment: Share text for a piece, followed by the link. 1: composer short name, 2: title, 3: hook (a full sentence).

share.text.moment %@ %@ %@ %@.en: %1$@, %2$@, at about %3$@: “%4$@” Listen with the guide on DailyClassical:
share.text.moment %@ %@ %@ %@.comment: Share text for one listening stop, followed by the link. 1: composer short name, 2: short title (“Symphony No. 6”), 3: time (“8:00”; Turkish adds the locative suffix in code, “8:00’de”), 4: the stop’s “What you hear” line as a sentence.

share.text.moment.untimed %@ %@ %@.en: %1$@, %2$@: “%3$@” Listen with the guide on DailyClassical:
share.text.moment.untimed %@ %@ %@.comment: Share text for a listening stop without a time (“Towards the end”), followed by the link. 1: composer short name, 2: short title, 3: the “What you hear” line as a sentence.
